Highlights Of The Jewish Media Awards!

Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 0:49
Instaread

The 3rd Jewish Media Awards are coming to Lincoln Center on November 5. We’ll be announcing this year’s winners and opening up ticket sales next month!

The 2nd Jewish Media Awards brought together some of the incredible people shaping Jewish storytelling and representation today. Winners included Fauda and Jewish Matchmaking, with presenters including Patricia Heaton and Emmanuelle Chriqui. This highlight reel gives just a glimpse of what made the evening so special.

Now, we’re getting ready to do it all again, but even bigger and better.

For now, take a look back at the magic of last year and stay tuned! We can’t wait to celebrate with you again!

If you found this content meaningful and want to help further our mission through our Keter, Makom, and Tikun branches, please consider becoming a Change Maker today.
